invariants.rationale: metaClient is likely always non-null as it is an essential context object for HoodieJavaWriteClient operations.
columnsToIndex is expected to be a valid list argument representing columns; null input is likely invalid.
columnsToIndex must be a List to support list operations within the method.
metaClient typically provides access to table configuration, which should not be null.
The size of a List is always zero or positive, by the contract of List.
